description: Land Acquisition - Kohuwala, Dehiwala D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land parcels being acquired by the government for a public purpose (construction of a flyover). It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, their locations, extents, and claimants, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property matters.
